While Job bathed naked, golden locusts fell on him and he gathered them, telling his Lord he could never do without His blessings.
Job, bathing, gathered falling gold locusts, and when his Lord asked whether He had not made him rich enough, said he could never do without His blessing.
Job gathered gold locusts falling on him as he bathed; asked by his Lord whether He had not made him rich enough, he said he could not forgo His blessings.
